statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let L := fun n : ℕ => max 1 (Nat.log 2 n / 2); let K := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (L n), Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t))/(L n:ℝ); let B := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | t ∉ arcs n ∧ (1:ℝ)/2 < K n t}; let m := fun (s : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral (s.indicator f) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, Even n → m (B n) (fun t => ‖S n (fun k => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) t‖^2) ≤ (n:ℝ)/640

plain_statement.zh: 完整冯·芒戈尔特指数和的共振能量预算
plain_statement.en: Resonant energy budget for the complete von Mangoldt exponential sum

brief.zh: 该算术猜想针对所有正素数幂，不带 k³>n 截断，可直接使用 Λ 的狄利克雷卷积恒等式。尝试 Vaughan 分解后分别控制小因子项和双线性项；必须在同一共振掩码上给出算术估计。
brief.en: This arithmetic conjecture uses all prime powers without a lower prime cutoff. Try Vaughan’s identity to expose small-divisor and bilinear terms. The estimate must apply to this exact resonant mask.
